name: pharsem/expo-sdk
description: A modern, dependency-free PHP SDK for the Expo push notification service, with honest send results.

suggest.ext-zlib: Compresses a request body above 1024 bytes with gzip, and decompresses a gzip answer.
suggest.psr/http-client: Sends the requests through any PSR-18 client, such as Guzzle, with Psr18HttpClient.
suggest.psr/http-factory: Builds the PSR-7 requests and streams that Psr18HttpClient needs.

scripts-descriptions.test: Runs the test suite. No test sends a real notification.
scripts-descriptions.coverage: Runs the test suite and writes a coverage report to build/.
scripts-descriptions.bench: Runs the local benchmark of planning, chunking and sending.
